title: Web sidebar: a second line and a status on chat rows
body:
Design: [docs/web/sidebar.md](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/blob/main/docs/web/sidebar.md) (phase 1).

Chat rows in the web sidebar show only a title. Give each row a quiet second line and a small status, using data that already exists.

**Scope**
- `openagents-ui`: `NavItem::detail(text)` renders a second line under the label (ellipsis, tertiary text); new `shell::ChatStatus` (Working, Waiting for you, Paused until <time>, Done, Failed) renders a dot plus words at the row's end. CSS in `static/components/shell.css`, catalog specimen, tests.
- `openagents-web` `pages::chat::chat_list`: line 2 = `repository · branch` from the chat's `Selection::repository`; status = Working while `pending` is set, Failed when the last request's outcome is `failed`, otherwise nothing.

**Acceptance**
- A chat started with a repository selected shows `owner/repo · branch` under its title; a chat without one has no second line.
- A chat with an answer in progress shows "Working" (pulsing dot, static under reduced motion); a failed last answer shows "Failed".
- The collapsed rail and the closed narrow panel hide both lines, as they hide labels today.
- `cargo test -p openagents-ui` and the chat page tests pass; the copy guard passes.
